description.default: Drag Markdown files, folders or ZIP archives onto the document tree to create documents, with images and attachments uploaded automatically. A result card appears afterwards, offering undo, retry of failed items, and the import log. The code was written entirely by AI; the author tested it.
description.zh-CN: 把 md 文件、文件夹或 zip 拖到文档树，生成对应文档，图片与附件自动上传。导入结束后弹出结果卡片，可撤销、重试失败项、打开日志。代码由 AI 全部完成，作者负责测试。
